sentences.en: You should inspect the car well before you buy it.
sentences.zh: 你买之前应该仔细检查一下那辆车。

sentences.en: Yanni was closely inspecting his windshield for any rock chips.
sentences.zh: Yanni正在仔细查看挡风玻璃是否有石子留下的裂痕。

sentences.en: To prevent hijacks, all carry-on baggage is carefully inspected.
sentences.zh: 为了防止劫持，所有随身行李都仔细检查过。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：in（进入）+spect（看）→进去查看→检查，检阅
